proof_body:
by
  intro n z hn hz
  have hn' : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hw : ∑ _i : Fin n, (1 : ℝ) / n = 1 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  have h := Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean_weighted Finset.univ (fun _ : Fin n => (1 : ℝ) / n) z
    (fun _ _ => by positivity) hw (fun i _ => hz i)
  calc (∏ i, z i) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / n)
      = ∏ i, z i ^ ((1 : ℝ) / n) := (Real.finsetProd_rpow Finset.univ z (fun i _ => hz i) _).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ i, (1 : ℝ) / n * z i := h
    _ = (∑ i, z i) / n := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum]; ring
